g.text: Title: Water Valve Controller - standalone ATmega328P

g.text: Single board, no Arduino Nano module

g.desc: Single board, no Arduino Nano module

g.text: ATmega328P-AU 16 MHz, CH340N USB-C, TPS54202H 5 V buck, AO4407A valve switch

g.desc: ATmega328P-AU 16 MHz, CH340N USB-C, TPS54202H 5 V buck, AO4407A valve switch

g.text: Pins: D2 flow, D4 button, D5-D7 LEDs, D8 valve, D11/D12 ESP, A0-A3 remote

g.desc: Pins: D2 flow, D4 button, D5-D7 LEDs, D8 valve, D11/D12 ESP, A0-A3 remote

g.text: POWER IN: RESETTABLE FUSE, MAIN SWITCH, REVERSE-POLARITY MOSFET

g.desc: POWER IN: RESETTABLE FUSE, MAIN SWITCH, REVERSE-POLARITY MOSFET

g.text: Off-board wiring: J1 12 V supply; J2 illuminated rocker switch (1 power, 2 load,

g.desc: Off-board wiring: J1 12 V supply; J2 illuminated rocker switch (1 power, 2 load,

g.text: 3 lamp GND); J3 valve (+ to 1, - to 2) and YF-G1 sensor (black 2, red 3, yellow 4);

g.desc: 3 lamp GND); J3 valve (+ to 1, - to 2) and YF-G1 sensor (black 2, red 3, yellow 4);

g.text: J5 button; J6-J8 plain panel LEDs; J4 ESP32-C3 (GPIO20 RX, GPIO21 TX).

g.desc: J5 button; J6-J8 plain panel LEDs; J4 ESP32-C3 (GPIO20 RX, GPIO21 TX).

g.text: Arduino pins: D0/D1 serial (USB), D2 flow, D4 button, D5-D7 LEDs, D8 valve,

g.desc: Arduino pins: D0/D1 serial (USB), D2 flow, D4 button, D5-D7 LEDs, D8 valve,

g.text: D11 data to the ESP, D12 data from the ESP, D13 LED, A0-A3 remote.

g.desc: D11 data to the ESP, D12 data from the ESP, D13 LED, A0-A3 remote.

g.text: Same pins as the Nano boards, so WaterValveController.ino runs unchanged.

g.desc: Same pins as the Nano boards, so WaterValveController.ino runs unchanged.

g.text: Burn the bootloader once through J10 (ICSP) as "Arduino Uno", then upload over USB.
